_comment: Illustrative Swytchcode policy set for the GitHub demo. Copy the relevant blocks into your workspace policy config, then run `swytchcode audit` to see enforcement. NOTE: the policy engine evaluates each call in isolation (stateless). See the 'Policies' section of README.md for which of these are actually enforceable.

enforceable_stateless.note: List repositories. Read-only calls carry no side effects; allow.

enforceable_stateless.deny_message: Pull requests may only target 'develop', never 'main'.
enforceable_stateless.note: Branch target is present on every create call, so this is enforceable per-request.

illustrative_requires_state.note: REQUIRES a persistent counter. A stateless policy engine cannot count issues created earlier today, so this cannot be enforced as written - see README.
REQUIRES a persistent counter. Same limitation as the issue rate limit above.
